title: Claude Opus 4.5
before: SWE-bench Verified scores had been climbing through the 70s all year.
problem: Whether agents could reliably resolve most real issues was still open.
breakthrough: 80.9% on SWE-bench Verified, the first model reported above 80, at a lower price than its predecessor.
why: The 80% mark was the year's psychological threshold for agentic coding. The figure is vendor-reported with its own scaffold.
inherits: Agentic coding as the headline capability measure.
